gbm_population_evidence.quote: Clinical diagnosis of presumed high-grade glioma, based on image data.

candidate_evidence.quote: understand how much of the drug is needed to reach brain tumors so it can be visualized best by surgeons
To measure of diagnostic performance of ABY-029, the false negative rate of ABY-029 fluorescence measured during surgery in tissue samples that are confirmed to be tumor through pathology.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Tumor judged to be suitable and planned for open cranial resection.

role_evidence.quote: Phase 1 Trial of ABY-029 Fluorescence in Patients With High-Grade Glioma

agents.drug_class_hint: fluorescently labelled anti-EGFR affibody imaging agent for fluorescence-guided surgery

coder_notes: Fluorescence-guided surgery imaging agent; no therapeutic candidate. Population is presumed high-grade glioma by imaging; glioblastoma not named. Intraoperative fluorescence measurement of ABY-029 in tumour is imaging for diagnostic performance, not antitumour PK; coded tumour_pk_planned no since no candidate exists. EGFR is the imaging target only; not recorded as a selection biomarker. Two dose arms, neither a control.
